videos.script: A threat has three parts nobody can do without. Something worth harming. Somebody who might harm it. And a way for them to do it. {{three}} The drawing gave you the ways. Today is about the other two. {{other}} What does the clinic have that is worth protecting? Clinical notes, obviously. But also the agenda, because a clinic with no agenda cannot work, and the payment status, because it is money. {{assets}} And who might come for them? Not only a hooded stranger. A receptionist who looks up a neighbour. A former partner who knows a patient's password. {{actors}} Put an actor and an asset together and you can write an abuse case. The feature as somebody will misuse it. And an abuse case can become a test, which is the cheapest place to catch it. {{abuse}}
